data.description: A unique form of magic-resistant mold grows upon the body of a vemerak.  This mold is the source of the vemerak's spell resistance.  When the vemerak moves, the mold exudes a cloud of spores in a 30-foot radius that acts as a targeted greater dispel magic (CL %1) against the highest caster level magical effect the cloud touches as part of the vemerak's move that turn.
data.name: Spore Cloud
